name: Kholkikos
body:
Kholkikos
CR 16/MR 6

XP 76,800
N Large dragon (fire, mythic)
Init +10/-10, dual initiative MA; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, scent, tremorsense 60 ft.; Perception +27

DEFENSE

AC 31, touch 11, flat-footed 28 (+3 Dex, +19 natural, -1 size)
hp 244 (16d12+140)
Fort +17, Ref +15, Will +16
Defensive Abilities deathlessma, poisonous bloodma (dragon bile, DC 23); DR 10/epic and magic; Immune death effects, exhaustion, fatigue, fire, negative levels, paralysis; SR 30; Weaknesses vulnerable to cold

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., climb 20 ft.
Melee bite +26 (4d6+11/19-20 plus grab), 2 claws +26 (1d8+11), tail slap +26 (1d8+15)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft. (10 ft. with bite)
Special Attacks breath weapon (40 ft. cone, 14d8 fire, DC 23), fast swallowma, mythic power (6/day, surge +1d8), swallow whole MA (4d8 bludgeoning and 4d8 fire damage, AC 20, hp 24)

STATISTICS

Str 33, Dex 16, Con 21, Int 15, Wis 18, Cha 20
Base Atk +16; CMB +28 (32 with grapple); CMD 41 (can’t be tripped)
Feats Alertness, Great Fortitude, Improved Critical (bite), Improved InitiativeMF, Improved Natural AttackMF (bite), Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Power AttackMF
Skills Bluff +24, Climb +31, Fly +20, Intimidate +24, Knowledge (arcana, local) +21, Perception +27, Sense Motive +24
Languages Common, Draconic, Ignan
SQ army of fangs, untiring

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Army of Fangs (Su)

A kholkikos’s teeth can be sown in the ground, sprouting into deadly warriors clad in breastplate and greaves and bearing spear and shield. A kholkikos can shed 2d4 teeth as a full-round action, causing an equal number of spartoi to arise 1 round later or at the GM’s option a mass of soldiers identical to a phalanx troop (see Appendix A, page 164). In either case, these soldiers are immune to the kholkikos’ breath weapon and serve the dragon for 2d6 minutes or until they are destroyed. The consumed teeth regenerate within 24 hours. After a kholkikos is slain, 2d4 of its teeth can be harvested as spartoi seeds; if not taken within 1 hour of its death, they lose their power.

Deathless (Ex)

A kholkikos cannot die of old age. It doesn’t take penalties to its ability scores for aging and cannot be magically aged. It is also immune to death effects and negative levels.

Untiring (Su)

A kholkikos is immune to the fatigued and exhausted conditions. It never needs to sleep, though it can still sleep if it wishes. Unlike most dragons, a kholkikos is not immune to sleep effects.

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate forests and swamps
Organization solitary
Treasure triple (plus 2d4 spartoi seeds)

The multicolored body of a snakelike dragon is intertwined with the branches of a massive tree. The creature lacks wings and rear legs, and its scales shine in all tones of green and gold.

This large greenish-gold reptilian dwells in rocky caves and clefts, hoarding its shiniest treasures. Their jaws can extend wide enough to swallow an entire human or sheep, and while digesting such a meal they may take on the appearance of torpor, but they are ever-vigilant, never needing to sleep, and are perfectly willing to lash out if their relaxation is disturbed. Hunting kholkikos, in fact, sometimes pretend to be sleeping in order to lure prey into coming too close, using their keen senses to track those coming near before leaping to the attack.

The kholkikos is solitary and prefers to be left alone; however, they are not immediately hostile to creatures they encounter. If bribed with additional treasures, especially items that glitter and shine, a kholkikos can be a diligent and faithful guardian, displaying its booty for others to see but protecting it with every ounce of their immortal life. They show affection to those that treat them kindly or bring them treats but also have a long memory for slights and those who have treated them poorly or offend those the kholkikos consider friends.
